chapter: Later career and The Benny Goodman Story
title: Who played in the Goodman Story band
summary: Wilson recalls Buck Clayton on the soundtrack and lists the original Goodman sections against the movie band with Stan Getz and Urbie Green.

story.theme_name: Working for Benny Goodman: the leader and his bands
story.community_name: Working for Benny Goodman: the perfectionist bandleader

blocks.x: Did Buck Clayton do any of that stuff?
Buck Clayton did the sound track, yes, and I think Buck was photographed in one of the scenes.

The original band, let's see, Hymie Shertzer was there from the original band, and I think Vernon Brown was there from the original band, and Gene Krupa. On the bass was George Duviver, and I think Allen Reuss, the original guitar player, was there. The original bass player with Goodman, of course, was Harry Goodman, Benny's older brother.
And then in the trumpet section, they had Conrad Gozzo and Harry James and I think Charlie Shavers was in that trumpet section. Of course, the original
Benny Goodman trumpet section would have been, in the heyday (Gordon) would have been Harry James, Ziggy Elman and Chris Griffin.

And the trombones would be Red Ballard and Vernon Brown, the reeds would be Hymie Schertzer on alto and probably George Koenig: Bill DePew on third alto, the tenor would have been Babe Rusin or Bud Freeman or Vico Muso and Arthur Rollini, Adrian's younger brother. That would have been the real personnel. And of course, Stacey on the piano.

But the movie band was a great band; he had Stan Getz in the reed section, because during a lot of the solo work and in the smaller groups doing solo, he had Urbie Green in the trombone section, the soundtrack, and also photographed along with some of the small group sessions. Of course, the original quartet was in the movie -- Lionel was there and Gene Krupa and myself, and we were all photographed because we did our own sound tracks. And I'm trying to think if there was anyone else that you know very well who was in that band who might have recorded who was not particularly seen on the screen.
Did Benny's brother go out there at all?
I don't remember seeing Harry around at all.
